instances.claim: This tells me that the piece has already described a force pulling the object out of physical existence — a dematerialization the object survived.
instances.why: "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" are conclusions about something that resisted disappearing, but nothing before line 7 raises any threat to the object's physical existence; lines 4–5 concern its monetary value, not its materiality. The premise it points at does exist in the draft — the hollowing-out, the split between materiality and meaning, the loss of objecthood — but it arrives at lines 14–18, after the line that depends on it.
